title: Geostatistics from Elliptic Boundary-Value Problems: Green Operators, Transmission Conditions, and Schur Complements
summary: Classical geostatistics encodes spatial dependence by prescribing variograms or covariance kernels on Euclidean domains, whereas the SPDE--GMRF paradigm specifies Gaussian fields through an elliptic precision operator whose inverse is the corresponding Green operator. We develop an operator-based formulation of Gaussian spatial random fields on bounded domains and manifolds with internal interfaces, treating boundary and transmission conditions as explicit components of the statistical model.
